systemsBefore.title: Systems and Addons Division
systemsBefore.remit: Systems Architect portfolio, addon engineering and technical support within individually accepted warrants.
systemsBefore.limits: The architect portfolio is classified with High Council; engineering support is Officer Corps. Neither classification appoints a holder or grants signing, platform or bank access.

systemsAfter.title: Systems and Addons Division
systemsAfter.remit: Architecture, addon engineering and technical support under individually accepted technical appointments.
systemsAfter.limits: Technical contributors are outside the High Council. A support appointment grants no Council vote, production access or signing authority.

propaganda.title: Ministry of Propaganda
propaganda.remit: Guild campaigns, recruitment storytelling and broadcaster-safe creative direction, with accurate claims and attributable sources.
propaganda.limits: The Minister approves campaign direction within the accepted warrant. Heraldry owns official records and publication standards; editors and platform operators retain separately granted access. No harassment, deceptive impersonation or private-information disclosure.
